title: Pullback of modules along an open immersion is restriction
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be an open immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-open-immersion]. For an $\mathcal O_Y$-module $\mathcal G$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] let $\mathcal G|_X$ be its restriction along $f$ as in [lem-weil-pbc-module-restriction-open-immersion-colimits] ($(\mathcal G|_X)(V)=\mathcal G(f(V))$), with the adjunction $(-)|_X\dashv f_*$ whose unit $\mathcal G\to f_*(\mathcal G|_X)$ is, on an open $W\subseteq Y$, the restriction map $\mathcal G(W)\to\mathcal G(f(f^{-1}W))$; and let $f^*$ be the pullback of modules [def-pc-module-pullback] with unit $\eta:\mathcal G\to f_*f^*\mathcal G$. Then there is an isomorphism $\kappa_{\mathcal G}:\mathcal G|_X\xrightarrow{\sim}f^*\mathcal G$ of $\mathcal O_X$-modules, natural in $\mathcal G$, such that $f_*(\kappa_{\mathcal G})$ composed with the unit of $(-)|_X\dashv f_*$ is $\eta$: for every open $W\subseteq Y$ and $g\in\mathcal G(W)$, $\kappa_{\mathcal G}(g|_{f(f^{-1}W)})=\eta(g)$ in $\Gamma(f^{-1}W,f^*\mathcal G)$.
